page_title: PAU 0-2 HEI | St. Pauli v Heidenheim 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is replacing Omar Haktab Traore.

90+2' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Heidenheim.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.
90' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli). St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elias Saad (St. Pauli) is coming onto the pitch as Connor Metcalfe cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' 0 - 2 Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) scores from the corner kick. The ball slipped through the box to Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) and he slotted it past the goalkeeper.
81' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) replacing Maximilian Breunig.
81' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Paul Wanner.
78' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) has tested the patience of referee Sven Jablonski and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Robert Wagner comes off the pitch to be replaced by Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli).
76' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Lars Ritzka will be replaced by Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Morgan Guilavogui trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
75' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
70' Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) makes a strong challenge and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
69' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Kevin Muller and he's equal to it.

66' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Paul Wanner (Heidenheim). Marvin Pieringer plays a fantastic through ball and finds Paul Wanner (Heidenheim), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
66' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) is about to take a corner kick.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to St. Pauli.

65' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to St. Pauli.
63' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
62' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Adrian Beck is replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
62' It's time for a substitution. Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) comes on in place of Leo Scienza.

62' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
61' St. Pauli will take a corner kick.
61' Decent spell from St. Pauli here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. Now St. Pauli have a corner.
60' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Heidenheim.

59' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

58' That didn't go as planned! Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Nikola Vasilj, who easily kept it out.
57' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
55' A cross into the box picks out Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
52' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
51' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
50' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
48' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.

47' The free kick finds Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
47' It seemed like Eric Smith (St. Pauli) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
47' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) commits a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
41' Robert Wagner (St. Pauli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

41' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
37' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
34' Dangerous play by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim). Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
31' The ball is crossed into the box and Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Muller gets a glove on it to thwart him.
28' Yellow card. Robert Wagner (St. Pauli) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
27' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

25' Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Sven Jablonski blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
23' A superb shot by Eric Smith (St. Pauli) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
22' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
21' Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Sven Jablonski no option but to blow his whistle.
20' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
18' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) is given a yellow card.
15' The resulting corner from Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
14' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
12' A pass by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
11' The referee blows his whistle as Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) was too aggressive in his challenge.
8' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) commits a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

4' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
3' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
3' Referee Sven Jablonski sees the trip by Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
St. Pauli will kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will officiate today.
